cards.body: Given 主張、前提與來源可定位。When 新觀察推翻推論或事實。Then 記錄原主張、前提、證據、失效點、支持結論及對下一步的影響。Negative 不能只調整驗收文字使候選變綠。Unknown 尚不能判定的因果保持 hypothesis。Replay 未變的已修事實不重做調查。邊界 修正事實不授權未知外部效果。回滾 還原候選資料，保留已證偽的主張與原因。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 所有資料綁定同一驗收對象
cards.body: 所有資料綁定同一驗收對象。核對 task、owner、session 或 N/A、head、需求與規格摘要、plan、環境、producer、sequence 及 artifact identity。 原要求 CL-04, CL-06, CL-11。失敗反例為跨任務／版本／producer 的 PASS 不得重用。

cards.title: 所有資料綁定同一驗收對象
cards.body: Given 選定 task、REQ、SPEC、來源與候選版本。When 接收事件或驗收產物。Then 核對 task、owner、session 或 N/A、head、需求與規格摘要、plan、環境、producer、sequence 及 artifact identity。Negative 跨任務／版本／producer 的 PASS 不得重用。Unknown 缺身分時要求原 owner 讀回，只停相依操作。Replay 重送同一事件識別回原結果；衝突拒絕。邊界 hash 證明 bytes，不能證明可信 producer 或授權。回滾 撤回錯配投影，不改原始產物。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 資料事件自動進入既有 owner
cards.body: 資料事件自動進入既有 owner。以驗證後事件觸發必要 Manager；owner 持續接續，不等新使用者提示；保存 request/result/consumption 關係。 原要求 CL-04, CL-06。失敗反例為未註冊事件或任意 argv 不得執行。

cards.title: 資料事件自動進入既有 owner
cards.body: Given Host 已獨立登錄事件 adapter 與授權。When 需求、來源、結果、hook 設定或等待條件改變。Then 以驗證後事件觸發必要 Manager；owner 持續接續，不等新使用者提示；保存 request/result/consumption 關係。Negative 未註冊事件或任意 argv 不得執行。Unknown 投遞結果未知先讀回；缺 adapter 回具名工程工作。Replay duplicate 不再產生效果；out-of-order 不覆蓋新結果。邊界 自動觸發沿原 owner，不新增排程器或 compiler 執行權。回滾 停用本次新增 binding，由原設定 owner 恢復上一版本。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Schema Manager 重算受影響投影
cards.body: Schema Manager 重算受影響投影。回傳 current state、前提證據、known/unknown、影響 REQ 及唯一支持的 next 或工程缺口。 原要求 CL-03, CL-04, CL-06, CL-11。失敗反例為無證據不能把 projected success 當實際成功。

cards.title: Schema Manager 重算受影響投影
cards.body: Given 事件身分與依賴有效。When 原 owner 提交已驗證的新資料。Then 回傳 current state、前提證據、known/unknown、影響 REQ 及唯一支持的 next 或工程缺口。Negative 無證據不能把 projected success 當實際成功。Unknown missing 欄位指明 producer 與下一個必要輸入。Replay 同一資料得同一投影；未消費 next 仍須接續。邊界 Schema 投影不授予 Test／Hook／Cron／landing 效果。回滾 撤回受影響快取投影，以保存 facts 重算。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Test Manager 按差異選必要驗證
cards.body: Test Manager 按差異選必要驗證。選 focused controls／必要 consumer observations；保存 exact selection、實際執行及原始產物，再回 Schema。 原要求 CL-05, CL-06, CL-11。失敗反例為格式檢查或 scope plan 不得算行為 PASS；不得推定 full suite。

cards.title: Test Manager 按差異選必要驗證
cards.body: Given 有變更範圍及原 oracle。When 新規格或結果需要判別行為。Then 選 focused controls／必要 consumer observations；保存 exact selection、實際執行及原始產物，再回 Schema。Negative 格式檢查或 scope plan 不得算行為 PASS；不得推定 full suite。Unknown known deterministic fault 用既有 control；缺憑證不觸發 eval。Replay 相同 bytes／inputs／claim 重用已涵蓋結果。邊界 scope owner 不兼任外部驗收 owner。回滾 回復候選，重驗受到影響的有限邊界。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Hook Manager 驗證原生載入與效果
cards.body: Hook Manager 驗證原生載入與效果。記錄 native trust、loaded、matched、invoked、completed、delivered 及原 owner effect readback。 原要求 CL-04, CL-06。失敗反例為設定檔存在或 fixture 綠不能算原生 hook 已啟用。

cards.title: Hook Manager 驗證原生載入與效果
cards.body: Given carrier 與精確 hook 定義已選定。When 定義或事件接線改變。Then 記錄 native trust、loaded、matched、invoked、completed、delivered 及原 owner effect readback。Negative 設定檔存在或 fixture 綠不能算原生 hook 已啟用。Unknown carrier 不支持 hook 時 K 保持未知，獨立工作繼續。Replay 同一事件不反覆要求續作；取消或終態不復活。邊界 不同 carrier 需各自證據；Codex App 無此能力不能冒稱 CLI hook。回滾 由原設定 owner 撤 binding 並讀回停用結果。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Cron Manager 用等待資料決定喚醒
cards.body: Cron Manager 用等待資料決定喚醒。以原 scheduler 建立／更新／取消具名 wakeup；醒來重查身分與 prerequisites，消費原 next。 原要求 CL-04, CL-06。失敗反例為無可做事項且阻塞未變不得重跑寫入；不得醒後重設预算。

cards.title: Cron Manager 用等待資料決定喚醒
cards.body: Given 同一任務仍有效且存在必要等待或接續。When 等待條件、deadline、授權或終態改變。Then 以原 scheduler 建立／更新／取消具名 wakeup；醒來重查身分與 prerequisites，消費原 next。Negative 無可做事項且阻塞未變不得重跑寫入；不得醒後重設预算。Unknown 缺平台能力或設定讀回時保留 K。Replay 重送同一排程 identity 不建第二份；終態與取消停止喚醒。邊界 Cron 只喚醒 owner，不決定需求或驗收。回滾 取消本次具名排程並取得原 scheduler 讀回。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Noodle Poteto 小迴圈完成可驗收單位
cards.body: Noodle Poteto 小迴圈完成可驗收單位。選原 Poteto playbook，讀相似實作，小步修改、必要驗證、自審 diff，回填本單位結果後继续其他可做需求。 原要求 CL-05, CL-08, CL-13。失敗反例為局部 commit／PASS 不能作整份任務 stopping point。

cards.title: Noodle Poteto 小迴圈完成可驗收單位
cards.body: Given 原 admission／execution envelope 固定且工作授權有效。When 已有可執行 task unit。Then 選原 Poteto playbook，讀相似實作，小步修改、必要驗證、自審 diff，回填本單位結果後继续其他可做需求。Negative 局部 commit／PASS 不能作整份任務 stopping point。Unknown 缺原 session 身分只停需要該身分的效果。Replay 原終態 session 不自行重啟；重送結果回原紀錄。邊界 本次交接不啟動 Noodle、不製造 admission。回滾 由原 owner 回滾該單位，保留失敗歷史。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Soodles 外迴圈維持全部需求分母
cards.body: Soodles 外迴圈維持全部需求分母。核對全部 REQ、未映射原句、缺件與下一步；可做項目继续，只有全要求具證據才整體完成。 原要求 CL-05, CL-08, CL-13。失敗反例為單一 owner next=null 或無新 bug 不能結束整份能力工作。

cards.title: Soodles 外迴圈維持全部需求分母
cards.body: Given 整份需求及全部局部結果仍可讀。When 一個小迴圈返回結果。Then 核對全部 REQ、未映射原句、缺件與下一步；可做項目继续，只有全要求具證據才整體完成。Negative 單一 owner next=null 或無新 bug 不能結束整份能力工作。Unknown 沒有原身份的歷史欠帳保留在原任務，不阻塞獨立新工作。Replay 終態新證據按原任務邊界處理，不重開生命週期。邊界 外迴圈不把 runtime 確認責任塞回 compiler。回滾 撤回錯誤 whole-task complete，回到剩餘需求。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 四個 Manager 結果回到原 REQ
cards.body: 四個 Manager 結果回到原 REQ。引用原 requirements digest 與 REQ ID，保存 Manager request/result、範圍、缺口和返回 next；再更新同一 handoff。 原要求 CL-04, CL-06, CL-11。失敗反例為分類 PASS、清冊或新檔名不能當原需求完成。

cards.title: 四個 Manager 結果回到原 REQ
cards.body: Given 已取得 selected Manager 的实际輸出。When 原 producer 發出結果事件。Then 引用原 requirements digest 與 REQ ID，保存 Manager request/result、範圍、缺口和返回 next；再更新同一 handoff。Negative 分類 PASS、清冊或新檔名不能當原需求完成。Unknown result 尚未到齊保持 pending，不填 expected。Replay 同一 result identity 不產生第二份 state store。邊界 資料按原 owner schema 轉換，不能假造互操作已成立。回滾 撤回錯誤映射，保留 producer 原結果。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 原 owner 消費返回 next 並讀回
cards.body: 原 owner 消費返回 next 並讀回。保存原 returned_next、實際 actor、合法輸入、執行結果及 owner readback；結果再回 Schema。 原要求 CL-04, CL-05, CL-06。失敗反例為只寫 consumed=true 或摘要不能算效果完成。

cards.title: 原 owner 消費返回 next 並讀回
cards.body: Given Manager 返回具名 next。When 原 Session 有合法接續且前提到齊。Then 保存原 returned_next、實際 actor、合法輸入、執行結果及 owner readback；結果再回 Schema。Negative 只寫 consumed=true 或摘要不能算效果完成。Unknown next 無 argv 時处理具名工程工作；寫入未知先讀回。Replay 未消費 next 即使無新 bytes 仍可做；已完成的效果不重播。邊界 owner 是職責來源，不必是另一帳號或另一 chat。回滾 由原效果 owner 撤回並讀回殘留效果。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 完成需具備整條資料閉環
cards.body: 完成需具備整條資料閉環。逐 REQ 核對來源、SPEC、必要 Manager 結果、owner consumption、效果及交付 readback；保留 knowledge/engineering/delivery 三軸。 原要求 CL-04, CL-05, CL-08, CL-13。失敗反例為schema 合法、CI 綠、report 自述或編譯 DONE 不能代替整體完成。

cards.title: 完成需具備整條資料閉環
cards.body: Given 整份要求無未映射項且必要結果存在。When 申報 whole-task complete。Then 逐 REQ 核對來源、SPEC、必要 Manager 結果、owner consumption、效果及交付 readback；保留 knowledge/engineering/delivery 三軸。Negative schema 合法、CI 綠、report 自述或編譯 DONE 不能代替整體完成。Unknown 全部剩餘項不可取得且有 producer 查證才申報 scoped blocked。Replay 已驗範圍與原始 failure history 保留。邊界 有限案例閉環不證明所有未知錯誤都可自動修復。回滾 撤回不符範圍的完成宣告，保留局部驗證。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 新事實使真正相依證據失效
cards.body: 新事實使真正相依證據失效。只失效其傳遞依賴的證據、confirmation 與 ready；保留不相依成果及舊版來源。 原要求 CL-10, CL-11。失敗反例為舊 PASS 不得覆蓋目前 FAIL。

cards.title: 新事實使真正相依證據失效
cards.body: Given 有具名 evidence dependency edges。When source／head／plan／SPEC／環境／readback 改變。Then 只失效其傳遞依賴的證據、confirmation 與 ready；保留不相依成果及舊版來源。Negative 舊 PASS 不得覆蓋目前 FAIL。Unknown 未知依賴須先查 owner，不猜全部通過。Replay 相同身份重送不失效；相同時間不代表無可做 next。邊界 保留歷史，不把 hash 當外部確認。回滾 從保留的事實與依賴重新投影。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 重播冪等且拒絕衝突
cards.body: 重播冪等且拒絕衝突。精確 duplicate 返回原 receipt；同 ID 不同 payload 拒絕；舊 sequence 不覆蓋新狀態。 原要求 CL-04, CL-06。失敗反例為不得靠新檔名／新 request ID 繞去重。

cards.title: 重播冪等且拒絕衝突
cards.body: Given 同一 task、producer、event identity 與 payload digest。When 重送或亂序到達。Then 精確 duplicate 返回原 receipt；同 ID 不同 payload 拒絕；舊 sequence 不覆蓋新狀態。Negative 不得靠新檔名／新 request ID 繞去重。Unknown 先前 effects unknown 時沿原 owner 讀回，不執行同一寫入。Replay duplicate 本身不產生新 effects 或 retry attempt。邊界 以原事件 writer 保留歷史，不新增重試 engine。回滾 停止本次投遞，查明原 event writer。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 未知寫入先讀回
cards.body: 未知寫入先讀回。停止同一效果重送，沿原 owner 查 readback；其他已知需求继续。 原要求 CL-04, CL-06, CL-13。失敗反例為改 identity、credentials 或換 session 重寫不合法。

cards.title: 未知寫入先讀回
cards.body: Given 已尝試写入且結果未明。When 沒有確定 receipt 或 transport 中斷。Then 停止同一效果重送，沿原 owner 查 readback；其他已知需求继续。Negative 改 identity、credentials 或換 session 重寫不合法。Unknown 尚未嘗試的可產生輸入不叫 unknown write。Replay 重複 missing readback 不消耗修正次數。邊界 不能把正確拒絕叫恢復成功。回滾 取得原 owner 的補償／撤回讀回。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 三次失敗後重審根因
cards.body: 三次失敗後重審根因。停止不變重試，記錄嘗試／錯誤／原因，質疑抽象並改採更小路徑；保留任務與预算。 原要求 CL-08, CL-10, CL-13。失敗反例為新 chat／新名稱／cron wakeup 不重設次數。

cards.title: 三次失敗後重審根因
cards.body: Given 已有可診斷的修正失敗歷史。When 同一問題第三次修正失敗。Then 停止不變重試，記錄嘗試／錯誤／原因，質疑抽象並改採更小路徑；保留任務與预算。Negative 新 chat／新名稱／cron wakeup 不重設次數。Unknown 缺證據與同一讀回不冒充修正失敗。Replay 再次讀回相同結果不新增失敗。邊界 重審根因不取消已知独立需求。回滾 回復最近可驗證候選，保存失敗三筆。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Thinking Router 只解除真正未決推論
cards.body: Thinking Router 只解除真正未決推論。選最小必要方法或 none，保存 trigger、reason、prompt delta 與未決輸入；事實先查來源。 原要求 CL-03, CL-14。失敗反例為不得把五種方法作固定 checklist，或替代 Poteto execute。

cards.title: Thinking Router 只解除真正未決推論
cards.body: Given 同一任務來源與有效 continuation 已知。When 出現實質未決意圖、前提或職責問題。Then 選最小必要方法或 none，保存 trigger、reason、prompt delta 與未決輸入；事實先查來源。Negative 不得把五種方法作固定 checklist，或替代 Poteto execute。Unknown 工具或上游 wrapper 未可用時不稱已執行。Replay 已回答且前提未變不重新問；現有 next 有效則沿用。邊界 方法是 P-class 提案；不創造 Issue contract 或 effect authority。回滾 撤回不受證據支持的方法及附加約束。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Ponytail 在外迴圈審查最小完整解
cards.body: Ponytail 在外迴圈審查最小完整解。選用可用的 Ponytail review，檢查所有必要呼叫者、測試、設定、失敗邊界與漏項，findings 回原 owner。 原要求 CL-13, CL-14。失敗反例為更短 diff 但漏需求、讀回或安全邊界不合格。

cards.title: Ponytail 在外迴圈審查最小完整解
cards.body: Given 具名候選 diff 與全部需求可讀。When 需要檢查多餘機制或交付 readiness。Then 選用可用的 Ponytail review，檢查所有必要呼叫者、測試、設定、失敗邊界與漏項，findings 回原 owner。Negative 更短 diff 但漏需求、讀回或安全邊界不合格。Unknown 尚無獨立 review／安裝證據時保持候選能力未知。Replay 相同候選與已涵蓋 scope 可重用 review。邊界 Ponytail 不另建 inner loop，不授予 merge。回滾 撤回多餘改動，仍完成原要求。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: Evals 綁定條件、行為與消費
cards.body: Evals 綁定條件、行為與消費。先 error analysis；客觀條件用程式或 receipts，語義 judge 須人標校準；保存真實 input／instructions／trace／report 與已消費 next。 原要求 CL-05, CL-12。失敗反例為自己填 expected、用 style 分數或 fixture 冒充實際 consumer 不合格。

cards.title: Evals 綁定條件、行為與消費
cards.body: Given 要驗的行為與原要求已固定。When 來源與正常 logs 不能回答 Agent 行為問題。Then 先 error analysis；客觀條件用程式或 receipts，語義 judge 須人標校準；保存真實 input／instructions／trace／report 與已消費 next。Negative 自己填 expected、用 style 分數或 fixture 冒充實際 consumer 不合格。Unknown 缺 human labels、完整 capture 或原生執行時只保留該證據缺口。Replay 未變 instructions、inputs、claim 可重用綁定觀察。邊界 來源審閱、模型觀察與原生 runtime 三者分開。回滾 保留失敗 protocol，修正有根據條件後重驗受影響決策。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 審計 v7.2 是否需要架構附錄
cards.body: 審計 v7.2 是否需要架構附錄。指出六個診斷區域的有據缺口，提出相容附錄，有限 consumer 檢查不宣稱因果改善或普遍可靠。 原要求 CL-02, CL-12, CL-13, CL-14。失敗反例為v7.1 未提供不能聲稱全部 inherited gates 已驗。

cards.title: 審計 v7.2 是否需要架構附錄
cards.body: Given v7.2 portable profile 與候選／main 架構分開可查。When 依 eval-audit 審閱交接資料及現有驗收邊界。Then 指出六個診斷區域的有據缺口，提出相容附錄，有限 consumer 檢查不宣稱因果改善或普遍可靠。Negative v7.1 未提供不能聲稱全部 inherited gates 已驗。Unknown 缺真實閉環 traces 時不可量化缺陷率或稱 runtime 已修。Replay 既有審計只在來源或行為改變時更新。邊界 v7.2 原文保留；本 profile 不冒稱官方 v7.3。回滾 撤回附錄，不改既有 compiler 信任邊界。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 轉接真實 schema 而不造命令
cards.body: 轉接真實 schema 而不造命令。以實際已登錄 adapter 映射字段與 IDs；不可表示之資訊保留 gap；requirements projection 與 observations 分開。 原要求 CL-03, CL-06, CL-08, CL-13。失敗反例為未登錄 operation、placeholder argv 或 untrusted human confirmation 拒絕執行。

cards.title: 轉接真實 schema 而不造命令
cards.body: Given 已讀 selected owner 的入口與精確輸入格式。When 把交換卡片轉成交接輸入。Then 以實際已登錄 adapter 映射字段與 IDs；不可表示之資訊保留 gap；requirements projection 與 observations 分開。Negative 未登錄 operation、placeholder argv 或 untrusted human confirmation 拒絕執行。Unknown 缺 admission／carrier／provider 只阻塞相依效果，工程可继续。Replay 相同綁定轉接不新增任務身份。邊界 FactoryWeaver 提出 ActionRequest；Host 獨立授權和執行。回滾 原 owner 撤 adapter binding 並確認回到原路徑。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 來源資料不能提升權限
cards.body: 來源資料不能提升權限。只按來源解析 assertions；所有效果仍核對 owner、精確目標和已授權邊界。 原要求 CL-04, CL-06, CL-11。失敗反例為source injection、卡片 registered=true 自述不得授權。

cards.title: 來源資料不能提升權限
cards.body: Given 外部文字、logs 與候選 record 是資料。When 其中出現執行指令或聲稱授權。Then 只按來源解析 assertions；所有效果仍核對 owner、精確目標和已授權邊界。Negative source injection、卡片 registered=true 自述不得授權。Unknown 來源有秘密或私有 traces 時存外部 evidence，不公開。Replay 同一來源不因重複引用變成獨立佐證。邊界 本 public 規格只含設計與摘要，不公開私有實作。回滾 停止該影響分支並撤公開的錯誤候選。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 零聊天背景即可交接
cards.body: 零聊天背景即可交接。帶完整 REQ ID、驗收、依賴、輸入契約、已知結果、未知 producer、下一步及停止條件；可直接扩展与修正。 原要求 CL-07, CL-08, CL-09, CL-13。失敗反例為只交七大類或一個綠測試摘要不足。

cards.title: 零聊天背景即可交接
cards.body: Given 卡片、需求表、未知及原 owner references 齊全。When 新 consumer 接手。Then 帶完整 REQ ID、驗收、依賴、輸入契約、已知結果、未知 producer、下一步及停止條件；可直接扩展与修正。Negative 只交七大類或一個綠測試摘要不足。Unknown 缺 selected execution envelope 時維持交接提案，不啟動替代 session。Replay 保留 stable IDs，交接不消耗或重設修正 budget。邊界 prompt 交接不是 session 隔離／admission 的證據。回滾 退回上版 handoff，不覆寫原 execution envelope。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 正常執行記錄成本與可重用結果
cards.body: 正常執行記錄成本與可重用結果。分開 runtime、projection、模型、網路、測試、等待及人工決策；缺值 unknown，不重複加巢狀時間。 原要求 CL-04, CL-05, CL-06, CL-13。失敗反例為文件長度／tool call／duration 不能推導決策減少或效益。

cards.title: 正常執行記錄成本與可重用結果
cards.body: Given 正常事件有來源和可用量測。When 收集一個小迴圈的结果。Then 分開 runtime、projection、模型、網路、測試、等待及人工決策；缺值 unknown，不重複加巢狀時間。Negative 文件長度／tool call／duration 不能推導決策減少或效益。Unknown 無量測本身不觸發 benchmark／修復。Replay 同一 log 重用，不為填報重跑原工作。邊界 成本 review 不替代行為／交付验收。回滾 修正錯算摘要，保留原 logs。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: PR 合併與規格狀態分開
cards.body: PR 合併與規格狀態分開。建立具體 PR、綁 exact head、確認必要 checks、merge main 並讀回 provider main；只完成規格交付。 原要求 CL-01。失敗反例為新規格 merge 不把 runtime requirements 標 RELEASE_CONFIRMED。

cards.title: PR 合併與規格狀態分開
cards.body: Given 本次 artifact 已讀回、自審與有限檢查完成。When 使用者已授權此次 PR 合併。Then 建立具體 PR、綁 exact head、確認必要 checks、merge main 並讀回 provider main；只完成規格交付。Negative 新規格 merge 不把 runtime requirements 標 RELEASE_CONFIRMED。Unknown 舊 Draft scope 未指明時保留，不替其驗收缺口簽名。Replay merge outcome unknown 先 provider readback，不重複寫入。邊界 此需求只交付本次筆記與評估，不實作所有 Managers。回滾 如需回滾，以新 PR revert 規格提交。Execution UNTESTED。

cards.title: 小步成功後還有整份要求
cards.body: 小迴圈得到綠測試時，原 owner 只能更新該 REQ。外迴圈仍保留全部原要求。閉環要看下一個 consumer 是否採用結果及效果讀回，不能停在文字報告。

cards.title: 資料閉環的定義
cards.body: 閉環由版本綁定事件開始，經必要 Manager 判定與原 owner 執行，再以實際讀回改變同一需求狀態。Schema 驗證只支持資料形狀。沒有事件接線、消費紀錄或效果證據，就缺一段閉環。

cards.title: 逐步實作順序
cards.body: 先固定意圖、完整需求與 SPEC，再補 adapter 字段能力。第二步接 event 到 Schema／Test。第三步證明 Hook／Cron 的 native binding。最後驗收 Manager feedback、owner consumption 與整份 stopping point。每步只聲稱所驗範圍。

cards.title: 三個調整方案
cards.body: 維持 v7.2 原文只補 prose 能交接人讀資訊，不能約束事件資料。改成 compiler 執行所有 Manager 會新增第二個 scheduler 並改權限。選相容 sidecar profile，保存 typed contracts 與觸發規則，效果仍由原 owner。這是設計判斷，沒有行為因果優勢的比較證據。

cards.title: 目前 runtime 驗收仍未執行
cards.body: 本次驗證卡片資料及有限指引消費。真實 Noodle admission／execute、原生 Hook／Cron、四 Manager 自動触發與 whole-task effect readback 均 NOT_RUN。候選說明或 schema 合法不能解除這些缺口。

cards.title: 「没有功能」需要縮限
cards.body: 原主張是 Data 驅動沒有自動觸發四 Manager。前提可能把未驗收當成未實作。來源審閱顯示部分入口與 feedback 已存在，但沒有本次 exact-task 的 native execution 證據。支持結論是整條自動接續未證明；先查 producer 與接線，不能重建全部 Managers。

cards.title: 查明原生接線與選定身份
cards.body: 缺 selected execution envelope、native hook／cron binding、四 Manager input adapters 及效果 owner readback。先由原 producer 查 source／normal logs，只有來源不能回答的行为才取 fresh observation。已知規格工作可繼續。

cards.title: v7.1 全文未提供
cards.body: 可讀 v7.2 是 portable profile。其宣稱繼承的完整 v7.1 不在本來源。只按 annex 所列不變量審閱，不宣稱 I-01..16 與 QG-01..34 全部語義已機械驗證。必要時由 compiler owner 供給原文。

notes.title: CS329Z MASTER CARD BOX · Whole-Course Knowledge Graph
notes.body:
# CS329Z MASTER CARD BOX · Whole-Course Knowledge Graph

> **The integrated course-wide Zettelkasten note**, not just a directory. Knowledge is organized by 11 weekly chapter roots, their Slides/Readings/Homework sub-boxes, and reusable Goal-oriented Behavior Scopes. Card claims remain **SCHEDULE_ONLY** until reading/slide evidence is inspected; effect evidence remains NOT_RUN.

## Whole-course Goal Contract

- **Goal:** choose, build, measure, improve and safely operate a correctly-scoped Agentic System that meets the *actually released* homework or project criteria.
- **Measurement:** source→REQ coverage, real HW tests and project objective metrics returned by the authoritative data/verification owner; course grades or test results are never guessed.
- **Persistence:** Boot the complete source inventory; incrementally Drill by chapter/source in bounded batches when source, dependencies or validation gaps actually change. Keep original goals across separate Issue Atoms.
- **Stop / Escalation:** compilation complete ≠ graded HW PASS or Runtime delivery; keep unread material, missing HW2 handout and owner-readback effects K until resolved.

## Chapter-card integration

| Chapter | Reusable conceptual bridge | Chapter-level Behavior Scope | Source notebooks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Week 1 · Foundations](chapters/week-01-foundations/cards.md) | Monolithic/Compound/Agent → Decision-oriented decomposition | Choose only necessary agent complexity | [Slides](chapters/week-01-foundations/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-01-foundations/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-01-foundations/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 2 · LLMs & RAG](chapters/week-02-llm-and-rag/cards.md) | Constrained generation & context → Grounding & retrieval | Ground corpus answers through verifiable retrieval | [Slides](chapters/week-02-llm-and-rag/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-02-llm-and-rag/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-02-llm-and-rag/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 3 · Tools & Frameworks](chapters/week-03-tools-and-frameworks/cards.md) | Tool schema and validation → Framework abstraction boundary | Execute a typed tool without accepting untrusted authority | [Slides](chapters/week-03-tools-and-frameworks/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-03-tools-and-frameworks/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-03-tools-and-frameworks/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 4 · Agent Patterns & Memory](chapters/week-04-patterns-and-memory/cards.md) | Agent loop and control → Durable memory and recovery | Maintain correct conversation state and bounded tool loops | [Slides](chapters/week-04-patterns-and-memory/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-04-patterns-and-memory/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-04-patterns-and-memory/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 5 · Multi-agent & Optimization](chapters/week-05-multiagent-optimization/cards.md) | Stateful delegation → Matched optimization/ablation | Show added complexity brings measured benefit | [Slides](chapters/week-05-multiagent-optimization/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-05-multiagent-optimization/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-05-multiagent-optimization/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 6 · Agent Data](chapters/week-06-agent-data/cards.md) | Traces and demonstrations → Feedback/data flywheel | Capture evidence for subsequent error analysis | [Slides](chapters/week-06-agent-data/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-06-agent-data/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-06-agent-data/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 7 · Data Quality & Benchmarking](chapters/week-07-data-evals/cards.md) | Data selection and labeled failures → Four-tuple evaluator | Build a realistic error-sensitive benchmark | [Slides](chapters/week-07-data-evals/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-07-data-evals/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-07-data-evals/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 8 · Judge & Safety](chapters/week-08-judge-safety/cards.md) | Judge reliability → Prompt injection/consent boundary | Reject unsafe effects and faulty judge conclusions | [Slides](chapters/week-08-judge-safety/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-08-judge-safety/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-08-judge-safety/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 9 · Coding Agents](chapters/week-09-coding-agents/cards.md) | Agent-computer interface → Observed coding-agent lifecycle | Close a bounded coding change using real owner evidence | [Slides](chapters/week-09-coding-agents/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-09-coding-agents/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-09-coding-agents/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 10 · Thanksgiving Recess](chapters/week-10-recess/cards.md) | NOOP (recess) → no new card | No new atom | [Slides](chapters/week-10-recess/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-10-recess/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-10-recess/homework/cards.md) |
| [Week 11 · Proactive Agents & Frontiers](chapters/week-11-proactive-frontiers/cards.md) | Proactive action thresholds → Observability and long-running recovery | Trigger only a justified consented action | [Slides](chapters/week-11-proactive-frontiers/slides/cards.md) · [Readings](chapters/week-11-proactive-frontiers/readings/cards.md) · [Homework](chapters/week-11-proactive-frontiers/homework/cards.md) |

## Cross-chapter graph (proposed semantic link types)

- **W1 → W2** `enables`: decomposition criteria determine whether retrieval belongs in the system.
- **W2 → W3** `depends_on`: grounded retrieval through tools depends on typed execution and source validation, while homework BM25 remains lexical when its tests require it.
- **W3 → W4 → W5** `enables`: reliable tool results, memory and state continuity precede delegation; multi-agent orchestration increases failure possibilities.
- **W5 → W6 → W7** `enables`: observed behaviors/traces precede valid datasets, and datasets precede evaluator/scorer conclusions.
- **W7 → W8** `validated_by`: an LLM Judge needs failure-specific controls; source code handles objectively decidable guardrails.
- **W8 + W3 → W9** `depends_on`: coding agents must respect tool permission and observed owner lifecycle, not generated text.
- **W4 + W7 + W8 + W9 → W11** `depends_on`: proactive agents need durable memory, measurements, safe authorization and controllable effects.
- **W10** Thanksgiving Recess: NOOP, no invented knowledge cards.

These are **semantic graph proposals**. Register real card IDs/versions through the existing Host/CLI, not model-produced strings. The v1 schema does not have a `constrains` relation; only use supported typed links for materialized records.

## Course-wide Behavior Scope portfolio

| Proposed Issue Atom | Goal | Measurement | Knowledge prerequisites | Outer Skill Route |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Retrieval/grounding | Answer with verified supporting evidence | HW1 BM25/QA tests | W1+W2 | `issue-atom`, Test Manager; Thinking Router only on real gap |
| Safe tools | Reject invalid and unauthorized effects | HW1 Tool Registry/Agent tests | W2+W3+W8 | `issue-atom`; safety controls; concrete `outer-review` if needed |
| Memory & continuation | Preserve only the required long-term context and no duplicate write | HW1 scripted memory cases | W3+W4 | issue-atom; conditional `think` for architecture |
| Trace data | Record useful failure evidence without conflating sources | trace completeness by original producer | W5+W6 | issue-atom; Test Manager |
| Valid evaluator | Distinguish actual failure modes and judge errors | held-out cases and verified scorer | W6+W7+W8 | conditional installed Evals / ablation; no judge for trivial code facts |
| Reliable coding agent | Bounded code change, accepted and receipted | provider readback / exact-head CI | W3+W8+W9 | issue-atom; `outer-review` only if actual candidate |
| Governed proactive action | Act on true trigger with consent, stop and recovery | native trigger and actual owner receipt | W4+W7+W8+W9+W11 | Hook/Cron only when original carrier requires |

**Inner loop:** Noodle Poteto consumes **bulleted semantic Prompt Delta requirements** for each actually admitted atom and chooses its engineering implementation freely within the fixed Scope. **Outer loop:** Soodles chooses/loads skills, maintains goals, measures outcomes, consumes owner next and handles publication/landing. This Master does not grant those effects.

## Coursework acceptance and cross references

- [HW1 · Build an Agentic Harness](coursework/HW1.md): W2 retrieval, W3 tools, W4 memory, W8 guardrails. Existing [source-bound HW1 Pilot](../../evals/cs329z-hw1/README.md) is a structural fixture, not an Agent behavior result.
- [HW2 · Evaluate an Agent](coursework/HW2.md): W6 trace data, W7 benchmark, W8 judges. Exact handout **unreleased as of 2026-10-13**.
- [Final Project](coursework/FINAL-PROJECT.md): choose one verified business/system outcome; do not force all course methods into a single Agent.

## Lossless Drill-down source backlog

- **K-slides:** five PDF links listed (lectures 01–05); no slide-page claims until PDFs are inspected.
- **K-readings:** 50 required/additional reading links listed; title-level questions await whole-paper source validation.
- **K-guest:** guest lectures scheduled TBA. No fabricated summaries.
- **K-HW2:** upcoming handout may change exact tests and submission requirements.
- **K-runtime:** no course-level real Soodles/Noodle execution, model judge, provider receipt or verified learning outcome is claimed.

given: The Original Owner supplies raw single-surface PatchProposal bytes and the complete fixed_inputs mapping: snapshot_ref, failure_ref, allowlist_ref, acceptance_ref, causal_target_ref, allowlist, and protected_target_refs. References are opaque; the parser does not load their targets.

producer: 原 generation／Trainer Owners
positive_control: Given a train-only sample with the selected policy’s own generation/action and matching independently verified replay/reward, return EligibleTrainingSample; update/freeze observations remain separate.
negative_control: Swap only reward reference, token actor or split: ineligible/quarantine. Eligible lineage plus an update of Codex or the unselected counterpart cannot satisfy the update boundary. Unknown provenance remains unknown, not reconstructed.
observation_status: Proposed NeoWeaver behavior controls: NOT_RUN. Actual specification consistency/CLI/source-review evidence is reported separately per covered subject; no native/training PASS is inferred.

cards.title: Causal attribution
cards.body:
actor: Evaluator 分開 Harness、Solver 與 interaction 的影響
goal: A=H0/φ0, B=H1/φ0, C=H0/φ1, D=H1/φ1; separate frozen Codex H0/H1 transfer
measurement: A=H0/φ0、B=H1/φ0、C=H0/φ1、D=H1/φ1 使用匹配條件；frozen Codex 另測 H0/H1；whole Goal需無hard-gate violation且有可重複正向paired effect
persistence: 保留原十項 parent REQ、原 Goal 與 acceptance；失敗後不重設 effort horizon。
stop_escalation: 未知 effect 先原 Owner readback；缺此需求必要資料只停止其依賴操作。
acceptance: A=H0/φ0、B=H1/φ0、C=H0/φ1、D=H1/φ1 使用匹配條件；frozen Codex 另測 H0/H1；whole Goal需無hard-gate violation且有可重複正向paired effect
non_case: 只看 D 或單次改善便宣稱成功、或不匹配預算／task population，均 INCONCLUSIVE；不將 interaction 當單一政策效果

cards.title: Causal attribution boundary
cards.body:
given: A/B/C/D 觀察或明示缺失，task/environment/budget/population 匹配。
when: 原 evaluator 比較固定 counterpart 並區分 component 與 interaction。 Proposed behavior；NeoWeaver native 執行尚未發生。
then: Report only identifiable components from matched observed arms: A/B supports HarnessDifference; A/C supports SolverDifference; all four support Interaction. Missing components remain NOT_RUN; unmatched comparisons are INCONCLUSIVE.
inputs_outputs: MatchedArms with original population/resource/oracle references → observed component differences with per-component availability. A/D can report a joint total difference, without component attribution; never synthesize missing arms.
forbidden: 只看 D 或單次改善便宣稱成功、或不匹配預算／task population，均 INCONCLUSIVE；不將 interaction 當單一政策效果
negative_case: Improvement in D alone cannot identify cause
unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。
replay: 固定 bytes、原 acceptance 與相同 scope 才可比較；已提供合法 next 時原樣 reuse。
oracle: Original evaluator checks B−A, C−A and D−B−C+A only when their matched input arms exist; positive paired repeatability and hard gates are separate whole-Goal requirements.
original_owner: 原 paired evaluator

cards.title: Causal attribution discriminating controls
cards.body:
subject: A=H0/φ0, B=H1/φ0, C=H0/φ1, D=H1/φ1; separate frozen Codex H0/H1 transfer
oracle: Original paired evaluator checks matched input availability and component formulas, with whole-Goal hard gates/repeatability measured separately.
producer: 原 paired evaluator
positive_control: Given matched A/B, report B−A as HarnessDifference and C/D-dependent results NOT_RUN. With all four matched arms, compute the three defined components. Whole Goal still needs its own repeatable positive paired evidence.
negative_control: Only matching A/D permits joint total D−A, not component attribution. D alone or mismatched budget cannot identify component effects; one positive pair or hard-gate failure cannot close whole Goal.
observation_status: Proposed NeoWeaver behavior controls: NOT_RUN. Actual specification consistency/CLI/source-review evidence is reported separately per covered subject; no native/training PASS is inferred.

cards.title: Scoped patch
cards.body:
actor: Proposer 針對一個被觀察失敗提出一個合法因果目標
goal: Only observed failure supports a single causal target; capability probe before generating plugin patch
measurement: failure ref 指向原 trace；target 在 Owner allowlist 內；原 Goal 與 acceptance 不變
persistence: 保留原十項 parent REQ、原 Goal 與 acceptance；失敗後不重設 effort horizon。
stop_escalation: 未知 effect 先原 Owner readback；缺此需求必要資料只停止其依賴操作。
acceptance: The failure reference identifies an observed trace, the target is allowed, and an explicit source-bound causal hypothesis explains its relevance. Hypothesis is not verified cause; plugin targets additionally need the applicable capability readback. Preserve original Goal and acceptance.
non_case: Generic quality complaints, unread source titles, unsupported plugin capability, out-of-scope effects, or absent observed failure do not justify a new failure-bound patch hypothesis. A separately proposed pure parser/refusal bootstrap is an implementation slice, not evidence of a prior NeoWeaver native failure.

cards.title: Scoped patch boundary
cards.body:
given: Original RolloutObservation, acceptance/allowlist references and applicable continuation are available.
when: Session prepares one failure-bound hypothesis for an observed target; absent failure or an unchanged valid continuation does not start another method selection.
then: Return FailureScope as a bounded hypothesis, preserve the existing valid continuation as NOOP, or name the missing input. This upstream scope decision does not parse a PatchProposal or prove causality.
inputs_outputs: RolloutObservation + original acceptance/allowlist/capability readback → FailureScope or named missing input; an unchanged legal continuation remains NOOP.
forbidden: 只有課程標題或泛稱品質不好、capability 未觀察、越出 path/effect scope，均 REFUSE／NOOP
negative_case: Proposed unsupported native Hook must be rejected
unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。
replay: 固定 bytes、原 acceptance 與相同 scope 才可比較；已提供合法 next 時原樣 reuse。
oracle: Original source review checks hypothesis-to-trace relevance and applicable capability. The parser later checks fixed references and targets, not the causal truth of that hypothesis.
original_owner: 原 observation／admission／Patch Validator

cards.title: Scoped patch discriminating controls
cards.body:
subject: Only observed failure supports a single causal target; capability probe before generating plugin patch
oracle: Original source/capability review checks the failure-bound hypothesis; parser checks the resulting fixed target/ref boundary.
producer: 原 observation／admission／Patch Validator
positive_control: Given actual failure evidence and an allowed relevant single target, produce a FailureScope hypothesis. Its legal proposal can be parsed; causal benefit remains for later matched replay.
negative_control: No observed failure or unchanged legal next: NOOP. An unrelated allowed target cannot gain causal acceptance from valid refs alone. Unsupported Hook: named refusal; unknown previous write: original readback, no retry.
observation_status: Proposed NeoWeaver behavior controls: NOT_RUN. Actual specification consistency/CLI/source-review evidence is reported separately per covered subject; no native/training PASS is inferred.

cards.title: Plugin transfer
cards.body:
actor: Adapter 將已接受 artifact 映射至目標 Host 真正支援的介面
goal: Verified artifact maps solely to capability-proven Skill, MCP wrapper, or supported lifecycle interface
measurement: probe 證明介面、bytes、load 與 fresh consumer consumption；保留安裝／執行／效果三種 readback
persistence: 保留原十項 parent REQ、原 Goal 與 acceptance；失敗後不重設 effort horizon。
stop_escalation: 未知 effect 先原 Owner readback；缺此需求必要資料只停止其依賴操作。
acceptance: probe 證明介面、bytes、load 與 fresh consumer consumption；保留安裝／執行／效果三種 readback
non_case: Plugin 被提及或 installer copied files 不證明 native consumption；缺 Hook event 或 trust 時不能宣稱 Hook 已執行；沒有能力不猜 API

cards.title: Plugin transfer boundary
cards.body:
given: 已接受 patch artifact、實際 target capability／trust 與原 consumer Owner 可用。
when: The capability adapter prepares a mapping only for an accepted artifact and an actually supported target interface.
then: Return a proposed mapping to the supported Skill, MCP wrapper or required trusted Hook, or a named refusal/gap. Mapping does not install, load, consume or execute it.
inputs_outputs: TransferArtifact + actual target capability/authorization readback → MappingProposal or named refusal/gap. Authorized installation, fresh consumption and effect receipts belong to subsequent native Consumers.
forbidden: Plugin 被提及或 installer copied files 不證明 native consumption；缺 Hook event 或 trust 時不能宣稱 Hook 已執行；沒有能力不猜 API
negative_case: Proposal != installed or consumed plugin
unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。
replay: 固定 bytes、原 acceptance 與相同 scope 才可比較；已提供合法 next 時原樣 reuse。
oracle: Original adapter mapping review checks supported interface and permitted distribution. Host load, fresh Consumer and applicable Provider effect each require separate actual evidence.
original_owner: 原 target Host／plugin／provider

cards.title: Plugin transfer discriminating controls
cards.body:
subject: Verified artifact maps solely to capability-proven Skill, MCP wrapper, or supported lifecycle interface
oracle: Adapter review checks mapping; Host capture separately establishes install/load/consume and applicable effect readback.
producer: 原 target Host／plugin／provider
positive_control: Given an accepted artifact and supported Skill/MCP capability, produce MappingProposal only. Native consumption remains NOT_RUN until a fresh bound capture; an unnecessary Hook is N/A.
negative_control: Same artifact with only a copied-file receipt cannot prove consumption. Unsupported interface refuses mapping; an actually required but untrusted Hook cannot execute. Missing native trace does not block parser.
observation_status: Proposed NeoWeaver behavior controls: NOT_RUN. Actual specification consistency/CLI/source-review evidence is reported separately per covered subject; no native/training PASS is inferred.

cards.title: Full lifecycle
cards.body:
actor: Soodles Outer 準備原 Issue／admission；Noodle Poteto 實作 admitted delta；原 Managers／Provider 各自回讀
goal: Soodles Outer chooses only real needed method and admission; Noodle Poteto receives bounded delta and implements freely; Test/Schema results read back; provider owns effects
measurement: actual Stage capture 顯示 consumed task／preselected playbook；必要 Test／Schema next 有真實 consumption；Provider 有 exact-head delivery
persistence: 保留原十項 parent REQ、原 Goal 與 acceptance；失敗後不重設 effort horizon。
stop_escalation: 未知 effect 先原 Owner readback；缺此需求必要資料只停止其依賴操作。
acceptance: actual Stage capture 顯示 consumed task／preselected playbook；必要 Test／Schema next 有真實 consumption；Provider 有 exact-head delivery
non_case: Writer Completed、reference CI、Reader next=null 不能閉合 parent Goal；不強迫所有 Managers 跑

cards.title: Full lifecycle boundary
cards.body:
given: 原 Issue Contract/admission、原 Stage task/playbook 與必要 Managers 的 actual readbacks 可讀。
when: The authorized Session consumes the original continuation at each applicable Issue, Stage, Test, Schema and Provider boundary; each result remains scoped to its own Consumer.
then: Preserve scoped Stage/test/feedback readbacks and their original next. Writer completion does not establish delivery or whole-Goal success; publication is required only where the original task calls for it.
inputs_outputs: Original Issue/Stage/Manager observations → their original scoped readback/continuation. Provider delivery and parent measurement are separate downstream inputs, never parser output.
forbidden: Writer Completed、reference CI、Reader next=null 不能閉合 parent Goal；不強迫所有 Managers 跑
negative_case: Writer-complete != merged/receipted goal
unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。
replay: 固定 bytes、原 acceptance 與相同 scope 才可比較；已提供合法 next 時原樣 reuse。
oracle: Original Stage capture establishes prompt/playbook consumption; selected Test/Schema evidence establishes its covered behavior and next consumption. Applicable Provider and whole-Goal receipts are checked independently.
original_owner: 原 Soodles／Noodle／Test／Schema／Provider

cards.title: Full lifecycle discriminating controls
cards.body:
subject: Soodles Outer chooses only real needed method and admission; Noodle Poteto receives bounded delta and implements freely; Test/Schema results read back; provider owns effects
oracle: Original Stage/Test/Schema/Provider Producers provide scoped evidence and actual next consumption; no single report proves all boundaries.
producer: 原 Soodles／Noodle／Test／Schema／Provider
positive_control: Given admitted Stage capture using the selected delta/playbook and selected control readbacks, report only scoped completion; leave parent delivery/measurement open when their receipts are absent.
negative_control: Writer completed without applicable Provider receipt is not delivered; returned Schema next without consumption remains pending. Reader next=null cannot admit a Stage. No native Hook/Cron need does not require invented events.
observation_status: Proposed NeoWeaver behavior controls: NOT_RUN. Actual specification consistency/CLI/source-review evidence is reported separately per covered subject; no native/training PASS is inferred.

cards.title: Learning dataset
cards.body:
actor: Dataset Owner 固定 train／validation／held-out，保留來源、rights 與 rollout→action→reward 的真實關係
goal: Training/validation/held-out partition; trace refs preserved; producer binds rollout/action/reward; legal rights for code/data/model/trace checked independently
measurement: train samples 有完整合法 lineage；validation 用於 acceptance；held-out 只做封存評估
persistence: 保留原十項 parent REQ、原 Goal 與 acceptance；失敗後不重設 effort horizon。
stop_escalation: 未知 effect 先原 Owner readback；缺此需求必要資料只停止其依賴操作。
acceptance: train samples 有完整合法 lineage；validation 用於 acceptance；held-out 只做封存評估
non_case: 猜 token、混 held-out training、使用權未確認、未裁決 reward 都排除更新；成本缺 capture 不是零

cards.title: Learning dataset boundary
cards.body:
given: 原 dataset rights、split、generation/action/reward lineage 與 checkpoint refs 固定。
when: Dataset Owner 隔離 train/validation/held-out；只將 eligible train samples 交原 Trainer。 Proposed behavior；NeoWeaver native 執行尚未發生。
then: Return only eligible TrainingBatch members; preserve reasons for quarantined and unknown samples. Near-duplicate leakage and held-out-driven patch selection cannot be hidden by distinct row IDs.
inputs_outputs: Dataset samples + original policy/action/generation/replay/reward/rights/split references → TrainingBatch of eligible train-only samples or named quarantine/missing-input reasons; no policy update occurs here.
forbidden: 猜 token、混 held-out training、使用權未確認、未裁決 reward 都排除更新；成本缺 capture 不是零
negative_case: A sample with guessed tokens, leaked held-out tests or noncommercial rights is ineligible
unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。
replay: 固定 bytes、原 acceptance 與相同 scope 才可比較；已提供合法 next 時原樣 reuse。
oracle: Dataset Owner compares each actor/action/reward and partition lineage, permitted use policy and leakage review. Unknown rights/provenance stop the dependent update, not parser work.
original_owner: 原 dataset／generation／verification Owners

cards.title: Learning dataset discriminating controls
cards.body:
subject: Training/validation/held-out partition; trace refs preserved; producer binds rollout/action/reward; legal rights for code/data/model/trace checked independently
oracle: Dataset Owner compares the selected sample’s policy/action/replay/reward, permitted-use and split/leakage references before forming TrainingBatch.
producer: 原 dataset／generation／verification Owners
positive_control: Given train-only own-policy samples with matching independent rewards, applicable rights and nonleaking split evidence, include them in TrainingBatch; no update is inferred.
negative_control: Swap a reward ref, use foreign on-policy tokens, relabel a held-out/near-duplicate task as train or select a patch after seeing held-out outcome: quarantine/refuse. Missing rights/lineage stops only the dependent update.
observation_status: Proposed NeoWeaver behavior controls: NOT_RUN. Actual specification consistency/CLI/source-review evidence is reported separately per covered subject; no native/training PASS is inferred.

cards.title: Lesson lineage
cards.body:
actor: Session 記錄被觀察的 first unsupported premise 與實際 rework DAG
goal: LESSON.md references observed issue/commit/PR relations and actual rework edges, distinguishing unknown from observed
measurement: LESSON 每個 Issue／Commit／PR edge 可讀回；正反控制能區分首個因果錯誤與後續症狀
persistence: 保留原十項 parent REQ、原 Goal 與 acceptance；失敗後不重設 effort horizon。
stop_escalation: 未知 effect 先原 Owner readback；缺此需求必要資料只停止其依賴操作。
acceptance: LESSON 每個 Issue／Commit／PR edge 可讀回；正反控制能區分首個因果錯誤與後續症狀
non_case: 補造 Issue ID、SHA、closure 或將歷史 NOT_RUN 改成 PASS，均拒絕；NeoWeaver 尚無 implementation Issue 不補一個

cards.title: Lesson lineage boundary
cards.body:
given: 原 GitHub/provider/capture events、原 Goal 與 fixed source quotes 可取得。
when: Session analyzes actually captured failure, repair and readback history. Current FactoryWeaver source reconciliation and future NeoWeaver runtime history are different observation scopes.
then: Return a source-bound first-premise analysis and evidenced rework edges, retaining unsupported edges as gaps. Observed FactoryWeaver commits do not prove NeoWeaver native execution.
inputs_outputs: ObservedHistory → FirstBreakpoint + EvidenceDAG + MissingEdge[]；沒有實際 Issue/Commit 不補 identity。
forbidden: 補造 Issue ID、SHA、closure 或將歷史 NOT_RUN 改成 PASS，均拒絕；NeoWeaver 尚無 implementation Issue 不補一個
negative_case: Do not invent SHA, DAG edge or closure
unknown_effect: 不能由 Card 判斷外部 effect；原 Owner 回讀前不重送。非外部資料檢查的 effect 為 N/A。
replay: 固定 bytes、原 acceptance 與相同 scope 才可比較；已提供合法 next 時原樣 reuse。
oracle: GitHub establishes identities/relations; original failed Consumer capture, repair diff and discriminating after-control establish the scoped rework explanation. Temporal order alone is insufficient.
original_owner: 原 GitHub／capture／source Owners

cards.title: Lesson lineage discriminating controls
cards.body:
subject: LESSON.md references observed issue/commit/PR relations and actual rework edges, distinguishing unknown from observed
oracle: GitHub proves actual identities; independent review compares original failure capture, repair diff and after-control to support a specific rework edge.
producer: 原 GitHub／capture／source Owners
positive_control: Given an observed FactoryWeaver failure/control, its exact repair and after-control, retain that evidenced source rework edge and its proof ceiling; future Neo native history remains NOT_RUN.
negative_control: Use two real but unrelated commits as a causal repair edge: reject that edge. Chronology, CI or merge alone cannot prove first cause or whole Goal. Missing capture remains a named gap, never a fabricated receipt.
observation_status: Proposed NeoWeaver behavior controls: NOT_RUN. Actual specification consistency/CLI/source-review evidence is reported separately per covered subject; no native/training PASS is inferred.

cards.title: Independent immutable verification
cards.body:
mechanism: Learning 只能提出候選；Execution replay 生成 observation；Verification 用 writer 不能修改的 oracle 決定 scoped acceptance。
conditions: 候選會影響 reward 或 completion，且原 verifier/source refs 可固定。
inputs_outputs: Patch proposal 與 paired observations → 原 verifier PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE；仍非 provider delivery。
failure_mode: 若 writer 能改 oracle，reward 反映自簽結果而非原 Goal。
decision_consequence: 把 evaluator、held-out 與 admission 排除 mutation allowlist。

cards.title: Actor scoped credit assignment
cards.body:
mechanism: Proposer action 與其 generation provenance、paired replay reward 連結；Solver tokens 由自己的 actor 產生。
conditions: 只有原 Producer 提供可一致連結的資料才形成 eligible batch；Codex 只做 frozen inference。
inputs_outputs: Rollout/action/verifier refs → eligibility；missing lineage → UNKNOWN/ineligible。
failure_mode: 把 Codex transcript 當 πθ tokens 會把不同 actor 的 action 歸因到錯誤 policy。
decision_consequence: 先訓獨立可追溯 Proposer；無 open Solver provenance 時不更新 Solver。

cards.title: Cards preserve original effect ownership
cards.body:
invariant: Card、Scope、Prompt Delta、Reader readback 都不授予 effects、admission 或 landing。
applicability: Proposal-to-native effects requiring original admission/continuation. The parser inherits no-effects protection; ordinary read-only work and expressly authorized local edits use their actual task/Host authorization.
authority_owner: 原 Issue/admission、native carrier 與 Provider 各自負責相應 fact。
refusal: For an operation that depends on original native admission, missing or invented next cannot authorize it. Continue independent authorized local/source work; do not manufacture permission or retry an unknown write.
consequences: local PASS／writer exit 不能升級為 native Stage 或 whole Goal closure。
exception: 原 Owner 已回有效 unchanged continuation 時消費它；沒有新增授權例外。

cards.title: Hard gates precede reward
cards.body:
invariant: Acceptance、protected regressions、rights、split 與 authority 任一 gate 未通過，都不能用 soft cost bonus 抵銷。
applicability: Artifact acceptance and reward interpretation after replay; training-sample eligibility has a separate rights/lineage/method check. Parser uses only the protected-acceptance constraint.
authority_owner: 原 independent Verifier／Dataset／admission Owner。
refusal: UNKNOWN gate 產生 INCONCLUSIVE；held-out 或 foreign tokens 排除 gradient。
consequences: A failed acceptance gate cannot be offset by cost. Whether a safe, rights-cleared task-failure observation is an eligible negative training sample depends on the original Trainer/Dataset method; this card does not decide it.
exception: 不需要的外部 effect 標 N/A；這不免除實際必要 gates。

cards.title: Harness only versus joint policy update
cards.body:
common_goal: 在相同 task/environment/budget 下找到可驗證的 outcome 改善。
alternatives: H1/φ0 只改 Harness；H0/φ1 只改 Solver；H1/φ1 同時改兩者。
dimensions: Actor provenance、因果可辨識性、受保護 regressions、可取得資料與 checkpoint。
tradeoffs: Fixed Solver A/B isolates a Harness difference. Matching A/D can report joint total change; separating its component/interaction attribution requires the corresponding additional matched arms. Missing costs or observations remain unknown.
selection_rule: For the first replay comparison, fixed Solver A/B can estimate Harness difference. Separate component/interaction attribution for joint changes needs the corresponding matched arms; a joint update alone does not require that attribution. Parser work runs no Solver.

cards.title: Joint result does not identify a component effect
cards.body:
premises: 同時改 Harness 與 Solver，且只觀察 A 与 D；沒有 B 与 C。
derivation: D−A 混合 Harness、Solver 及 interaction。多組 B/C 值可得到同一 D−A，因此無法唯一歸因。
applicability: 原規格 matched four-arm attribution；不是所有 observational data 的普遍定律。
counterexample: 若 Solver 完全固定且有匹配 B/A，可識別該 scoped Harness difference；仍不能外推全 population。
implication: With only matching A/D, report the observed joint total difference, while component/interaction attribution remains INCONCLUSIVE. D alone provides no comparison; do not invent B/C or erase actual observed outcomes.

cards.title: Choose the first evaluation population
cards.body:
unresolved_decision: This inspected specification has no accepted initial task population/resource/evaluation selection. Read the original Owner’s current records before concluding that the choice is unresolved.
competing_answers: 使用既有 Owner 固定的 repository task set，或由產品 Owner 明確選另一個可重放 task population；無已觀察選擇。
decision_owner: 原 Goal／Dataset／measurement Owner；Session 先讀既有 artifacts，未解的產品選擇才需決定。
impact: Only replay/performance acceptance depends on the population choice; parser/refusal fixture work can continue without it.
next_evidence: 取得原 population、oracle、split 與 budget 的已接受資料，不重問已解決 Goal。

cards.title: Start at the patch acceptance boundary
cards.body:
goal: 合法 single-surface proposal 保留 immutable acceptance；非法輸入 fail closed。
causal_hypothesis: 先固定 parser／validator 可避免未驗收候選污染 replay/reward；尚未測 NeoWeaver。
intervention: A proposed pure parser/refusal bootstrap atom returns ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal without replay, reward, training or native effects. This is not an observed NeoWeaver runtime defect.
alternative: 若原 source 顯示另一個更早 failure，先修其原 Producer，不建立無需要的 parser layer。
measurement: Owner-fixed allowed single-surface input and duplicate/stale/protected-target/extra-effect negative inputs discriminate parser outcomes; native execution remains NOT_RUN.
stop_rule: Missing native admission blocks only dependent native work; independent authorized local parsing can continue. Under the applicable original Session correction policy, three failed authorized corrections trigger causal reassessment in the same task, not an automatic Parser retry counter or a new scheduler. Never relax immutable acceptance.

cards.title: Verify a bounded delivery sequence
cards.body:
parent_goal: 有界 Harness learning 與 verified frozen Codex transfer，原十項 REQ 全保留。
units: Candidate Parser unit: S-start-at-the-patch-acceptance-boundary Strategy with SPEC-trainability-boundary local ParsedProposal/DiagnosticRefusal exit; parent Replay/Training is not completed by Parser. Then matched replay → independent gates → eligible Proposer update. Optional Solver update remains separate. Accepted artifact plus target capability enables authorized transfer without that optional Solver branch; Provider/LESSON follow applicable delivery.
prerequisites: Reward uses actual matched replay/gates; updates use eligible data and authorized method. Transfer requires an accepted artifact and target capability, not an optional Solver update.
exit_gates: Parser→合法解析與非法無effect；Replay→matched observations；Verification→固定oracle與lineage；Proposer→eligible train-only batch與rollback checkpoint；Solver→自身provenance且counterpart固定；Transfer→capability/install/load/consume/effect各自讀回；Delivery→Provider與無hard-gate violation、可重複正向paired effect。詳細正反/unknown/replay在完整規格逐步交付矩陣；未觀察仍NOT_RUN。
owner_continuation: 既有原 Owner next 決定實際 lifecycle；此 Roadmap 不建立排程器。

cards.title: Repeat a matched replay safely
cards.body:
preconditions: 原固定 snapshot、budget、oracle、mutation allowlist 與許可環境可用。
procedure: 保留 baseline，使用另一個 isolated copy 套已通過 parser/scope checks且原Owner允許進disposable replay的candidate；此時尚未得到outcome acceptance。原 runner記錄兩組observations，再交獨立Verifier。
validation: 核對 matched conditions、protected negative controls、terminal/capture coverage與原 acceptance。
failure_recovery: unknown effect 讀原 Owner，不 replay write；missing observation 保留 INCONCLUSIVE。
rollback: 由原 effect Owner 從其原 checkpoint/ref 恢復；Practice card 不授權 rollback。
scope: 可重用 proposed replay practice，非 Soodles P-class instruction 或已執行模型實驗。

cards.title: FactoryWeaver reconciliation precedes NeoWeaver recompilation
cards.body:
actors: 使用者要求續作；Session 修復 source；獨立 reviewers 驅動 CLI；GitHub 提供 head/CI/merge。
initial_state: The inspected reconciliation documents record portable dependencies, coverage refusal, profile ambiguity and missing legacy consumers that required source repairs; no unreferenced draft-count assertion is made.
event_sequence: 先修 portable deps/trusted checker，再補 coverage refusal、profile ambiguity，最後恢復 PR7 missing consumers。
turning_point: 實際 negative cases 揭露綠測試沒有覆蓋的 Consumer 契約缺口，不能直接合併旧 source。
outcome: 獨立 scoped CLI 證據與 GitHub source delivery可讀回；NeoWeaver原生learning仍未執行。
causal_uncertainty: 這條實際 rework sequence 不證明 native Agent compliance、decision cost降低或RL成效。

cards.title: Matching raw catalog pin still allowed duplicate keys
cards.body:
case: 原 Profile auditor 曾以普通 JSON decoder 讀取 exact-pin catalog。
condition: 同一 raw object 含兩個 producer_claim keys，後者為 UNVERIFIED_CARRIER_OUTPUT。
observed_detail: 獨立負例指出不同 parser 可有不同解讀；修正沿用 main duplicate-key refusal，raw pin 不被當語義正確。
countercase: Unique-key synthetic catalog with a matching supplied raw pin returns EFFECTIVE_CATALOG_CLAIM_MATCHES, with native Worker verification false; duplicate keys refuse even when the raw pin matches.
implication: NeoWeaver Parser 亦需單義 input；這是已觀察 FactoryWeaver case，不是 NeoWeaver implementation failure。

cards.title: Training data and token provenance unavailable
cards.body:
missing_input: The inspected bundle has no actual authorized train split/own-generation/action/reward lineage or model/data rights readback. This is a coverage gap in this source, not proof that no Owner possesses those inputs.
why_required: 沒有它們不能形成合法 policy-gradient batch 或主張 performance。
producer: 原 Dataset、generation、Verifier／Trainer Owners。
affected_scope: 真實 Proposer/Solver update 與成效 acceptance。
next_source: 讀原已授權資料與 capture；不從 transcript 補造 token、logprob或reward。
unaffected_work: 完整規格、PatchProposal shape、parser fixtures及 source/CLI拒絕驗證。

cards.title: Native Codex transfer has no observed consumer
cards.body:
missing_input: Actual target capability, authorized distribution, load and fresh Consumer evidence are not observed in this bundle. A trusted Hook definition and native event are required only if that target actually needs a Hook.
why_required: 官方文件與filesystem installation不能證明本目標consumer消費learned patch。
producer: 原 target Host、Codex carrier、plugin與Provider Owners。
affected_scope: REQ-07 native transfer及whole Goal closure。
next_source: 先讀實際capability與原next；需要Hook時保留真實event/trust，不能猜API。
unaffected_work: 官方介面來源核對、source-bound artifact與唯讀CLI交接。
